lead_type.help: Type is used to separate Leads and Opportunities

date_deadline.help: Estimate of the date on which the opportunity will be won.

partner_id.help: Linked partner (optional). Usually created when converting the lead. You can find a partner by its Name, TIN, Email or Internal Reference.

partner_name.help: The name of the future partner company that will be created while converting the lead into opportunity

tag_ids.help: Classify and analyze your lead/opportunity categories like: Training, Service

user_company_ids.help: UX: Limit to lead company or all if no company

sql_constraints: The probability of closing the deal should be between 0% and 100%!

crm.lead2opportunity.partner.description: Convert Lead to Opportunity (not in mass)

selection: Do not link to a customer

force_assignment.help: If checked, forces salesman to be updated on updated opportunities even if already set.

crm.lead2opportunity.partner.name: crm.lead2opportunity.partner

deduplicate.help: Merge with existing leads/opportunities of each partner

crm.recurring.plan.name: crm.recurring.plan
sql_constraints: The number of month can't be negative.

fold.help: This stage is folded in the kanban view when there are no records in that stage to display.

requirements.help: Enter here the internal requirements for this stage (ex: Offer sent to customer). It will appear as a tooltip over the stage's name.

sequence.help: Used to order stages. Lower is better.

team_id.help: Specific team that uses this stage. Other teams will not be able to see or use this stage.

alias_id.help: The email address associated with this channel. New emails received will automatically create new leads assigned to the channel.

assignment_domain.help: Additional filter domain when fetching unassigned leads to allocate to the team.

assignment_max.help: Monthly average leads capacity for all salesmen belonging to the team

lead_all_assigned_month_count.help: Number of leads and opportunities assigned this last month.

lead_all_assigned_month_exceeded.help: True if the monthly lead assignment count is greater than the maximum assignment limit, false otherwise.

use_leads.help: Check this box to filter and qualify incoming requests as leads before converting them into opportunities and assigning them to a salesperson.

use_opportunities.help: Check this box to manage a presales process with opportunities.

lead_day_count.help: Lead assigned to this member this last day (lost one excluded)

lead_month_count.help: Lead assigned to this member those last 30 days

crm_auto_assignment_action.help: Manual assign allow to trigger assignment from team form view using an action button. Automatic configures a cron running repeatedly assignment in all teams.

crm_auto_assignment_interval_number.help: Number of interval type between each cron run (e.g. each 2 days or each 4 days)

crm_auto_assignment_interval_type.help: Interval type between each cron run (e.g. each 2 days or each 2 hours)
